title: Trusting Allah with an Uncertain Future
paragraphs: As her graduation approached without any concrete job prospects lined up, Salma felt increasingly anxious watching several classmates secure positions while her own applications repeatedly went unanswered for weeks at a time.

Her father reminded her of a principle he had relied on throughout his own career: that reasonable effort combined with sincere trust in Allah's plan mattered more than obsessively controlling every possible outcome.

This perspective did not eliminate her uncertainty entirely, but it allowed her to continue applying methodically rather than spiraling into the kind of despair that made productive effort increasingly difficult to sustain.

Eight months after graduation, considerably longer than she had originally hoped, Salma secured a position that ultimately suited her far better than the opportunities she had initially pursued so anxiously.
